exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: Newborns (n=210) and their mothers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage, low birth weight, preterm birth, caesarean section delivery, instrumental delivery, fetal distress, and meconium-stained amniotic fluid were significantly associated with perinatal asphyxia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery and instrumental delivery were significantly associated with perinatal asphyxia.
